5-Q4: cidcname1
        ;

Q4 (5) 

select c.cid, c.cname
from customers c, products p, agents a, orders o
where o.cid = c.cid and o.pid = p.pid and o.aid = a.aid and a.city = '' and p.price > 1
group by c.cid, c.cname
having count(distinct o.pid) = (select count(*) from products where price > 1) ;

      and not exists (                                         x.ordno < y.ordno and

            from orders z

select distinct x.tno, x.tcyear FIRST_YEAR, y.tcyear LAST_YEAR               2
from TC x, TC y
where x.tno=y.tno and

     x.tcyear <= ALL ( select TC.tcyear from TC where TC.tno = x.tno ) and
     y.tcyear >= ALL ( select TC.tcyear from TC where TC.tno = x.tno ) ;

12- 1000
         

select tno, count(*), sum(hours)
from TC
group by tno
having sum(hours) > 1000
order by sum(hours) DESC ;

        `'`'

 select S.sno, S.dept, AVG(R.grade*0.05*C.credit) as avgofcred
 from Student S, SC R, Course C
 where S.sno=R.sno and R.cno=C.cno and

         S.sno not in ( select x.sno
                        from SC x, Course y
                        where x.cno=y.cno and y.optional='' and x.grade < 60 )

 group by S.sno, S.dept
 order by S.dept ASC, avgofcred DESC ;

        `'

create view stud_view as
     select S.sno, S.sname, S.dept, Y.sumofcred, Z.avgofcred
     from Student S,
           ( select R.sno, sum(C.credit)
             from SC R, Course C
             where R.cno=C.cno and R.grade>=60
             group by R.sno ) AS Y(sno, sumofcred) ,
           ( select R.sno, AVG(R.grade*0.05*C.credit)
             from SC R, Course C
             where R.cno=C.cno and C.optional=''
             group by R.sno ) AS Z(sno, avgofcred)
     where S.sno=Y.sno and S.sno=Z.sno ;



 
    FROM
